description: vs - open the right solution in the right Visual Studio: finds every .sln/.slnx below the current folder, picks among several, and matches each to an installed Visual Studio.
post_install: # The registry PSModulePath was just extended; this process still has the old value.
$mods = if (Get-Command modulesdir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { modulesdir $global } else { Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $dir))) 'modules' }
post_uninstall: # Runs on every update too, so it says nothing: a leftover profile line is harmless (README -> Uninstall).
notes: 'vs' works now, from any shell (a Scoop shim). Type 'vs help' to start.
For Tab completion in PowerShell, import the module from your profile: vs install profile
